general.notes: Features state low power dissipation <5W and aggregate bit rates 212.5 Gb/s and 103.125 Gb/s if required. Maximum link length stated as 70 m on OM3 MMF and 100 m on OM4 and OM5 MMF (title: 100mReach); not given in km. Receiver Sensitivity (OMAouter) -7 dBm per Note3 measured with conformance test signal at TP3 for BER = 2.4E-4 Pre-FEC. Stressed Receiver Sensitivity (OMAouter) -3 dBm. Electrical BER Note2 max 2.4E-4 compliant with 200GBASE-SR4 electrical specification in IEEE 802.3cd. Optical connector described as single MPO12 receptacle and male MPO connector. RMS spectral width max 0.6 nm. Damage threshold (receiver) max 4 dBm. LPMode section references QSFP28 modules in error; product is QSFP56.
provenance_datasheet_sections: Note3. Measured with conformance test signal at TP3 for BER = 2.4E-4 Pre-FEC
general.suggestions: Add reach_m or accept meter values for SR modules; map QSFP56 to form_factor enum; optional fields for OMAouter launch/receive limits and TDECQ.
